course.title: Power System Protection
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: A 200 kV long X-mission line has an impedance of (2+j8) Ω. Suggest suitable (14) distance relays for its protection and determine the setting of the relays for all the zones given that
(i) Zone-I covers 80% of the line length
(ii) Zone-II covers 150% of the line length
(iii) Zone-III covers 225% of the line length
Assume a fault resistance of 2 Ω while deciding setting and a suitable characteristics angle of the distance relay suggested by you. Given that CT ratio = 1000/1 A and PT ratio = 220 kV/110 V.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
